reviews.text: First visit for our kitten, the team was very gentle and kind.

⚠️ WARNING if you have your cat spayed at this clinic.

Following my cat's spaying, a huge bandage was stuck directly onto her skin and fur, about 0.3 cm from the incision. As a result, it's completely stuck and impossible to remove without causing her significant pain. The adhesive is so firmly attached to her fur and skin that every attempt to remove it hurts her.

I find this completely unacceptable and unacceptable after surgery. I especially feel there's no delicacy or care taken when handling animals. A suitable compress could have been used instead of sticking such a large bandage directly on.

An animal has just undergone surgery, so it seems obvious to me that one must be particularly gentle and attentive to its comfort!

Update 09/24: I learned today that this was due to miscommunication with the receptionist, not the veterinarians.

There should have been more follow-up with the veterinarians. The receptionist that day clearly told us nonsense…

Hello 🤗
Thank you for your positive feedback. Your trust and satisfaction are essential.

Best regards,
The Mon Véto Marseille La Plaine Team

Three years later… finally able to write. Two medications that shouldn't be prescribed together, and my three-year-old cat is left without an immune system. He develops FIP (just before the treatment was authorized in France). I have to have him put down; he's suffering too much, he's doomed. Dr. L admits his mistake, uneasy about having killed my cat.

Traumatized. Watching him go, trembling with fever, nestled in my arms (thank you to the Cabassu clinic for their kindness, their quick response in the emergency, and their patience).

You should stop practicing. I hope that sometimes, you think of him.
Excellent welcome and care for our cat Kevin; thank you to Dr. Ariane Will.

I always receive a warm welcome at this veterinary clinic; the assistants are very patient and attentive.

The veterinary team is particularly dedicated to the well-being of the animals.

A huge thank you for your care.

Hello, I'm really disappointed because I was only 15 minutes late.

So I was told that my dog ​​wouldn't be examined.
There was no one left after my appointment.
With Dr. Djaffar, it was different; he did everything for the animal's well-being.
Always welcoming, understanding, and above all, professional.
How we miss you, Dr. Djaffar!

Disappointing coming from a veterinary clinic. No customer service, no empathy. They're only in it for the money. They don't like animals. The receptionist is very bitter and disrespectful. I don't recommend them if you love your pets.

A very good team; they've been caring for my animals for seven years and have demonstrated exceptional compassion and professionalism on numerous occasions. They've since been acquired by a large corporation, which has led to a significant price increase and a focus on profitability. I also feel that Dr. Jaafar's departure leaves a big void. That said, they remain a team dedicated to animal welfare and supportive of their patients' owners.
Very professional. I recommend them.
Excellent service, perfect cat surgery, very attentive and kind. I highly recommend them, absolutely adorable, thank you so much for cat ❤️

I do not recommend this veterinary clinic. My small dog had a broken claw on his left front paw. To remove the claw, the staff (two people) held my dog ​​so tightly that they caused an injury to his eye. It's the first time I've ever seen such a violent way of handling a small dog.

Warning!!! The website is down (error 404). The online appointment booking tools are also out of order and show no availability. So, if you don't want to feel as foolish as I did, avoid going there with your pet without having booked an appointment through some other means… because it's pointless except for booking an appointment.

Obviously, don't try to contact them during your lunch break… they're on break and no one will bother to call you back afterward.

As for the quality of the staff, they may be competent, but I don't know, I wasn't even able to verify it. However, I strongly advise against this establishment, unless you have time to waste, for both yourself and your pet.

If you're still reading this review, it's probably because your pet is in an emergency situation… unfortunately, the word "emergency" doesn't seem to be in this clinic's vocabulary. It was my first time setting foot in this clinic… and it will definitely be my last.

Nevertheless, a big thank you to the young woman at reception, who seemed very concerned about the situation and showed a lot of compassion despite the fact that there was nothing she could do except give me an appointment for the next day. She was very pleasant. Thank you to her.

KINDNESS
COMPETENCE
PERFECT

My second visit today, November 8th...
still just as satisfied.

Thank you!!!
An excellent veterinary clinic

A very friendly team. It's always a pleasure to go there to get my cat's food. They are very welcoming and always explain everything perfectly.
The vets are also excellent. I highly recommend this practice!

A huge thank you to the entire team who took care of my dog ​​so quickly after an emergency!

They acted swiftly and effectively! Thanks to them, my beloved little dog was able to celebrate his 5th birthday in perfect health!

They are as kind to humans as they are to our four-legged companions.... A heartfelt thank you to the team for your kindness and support!
Sophie and Rocket

Thank you to Dr. Smith for his professionalism, patience, and expertise.
Consultation for a herniated disc in my French Bulldog.
The clinic staff is also excellent.
I recently went there for my old girl Wendy (a 14-year-old cat). You can go without hesitation! The team is fantastic, attentive, passionate, and full of great advice!

Our dogs and cats have been followed for a very long time by this highly professional clinic, which is also very attentive to our animals and to us. The veterinarians and assistants know how to advise and guide us in our choices, even during difficult times.

After 20 years of wonderful adventures and excellent care at the Plaine clinic, our Kiara has passed away. The last photo was taken four days before she left us; she was almost 20 years old and still looked so beautiful. Thank you to the team for the care and advice that allowed her to spend her final days in the best possible conditions.

Eros has been a patient at this clinic for 16 years. I want to commend all the staff, from the doctors to the secretaries. I highly recommend this clinic for your little ones; they will receive excellent care, and everyone is available and also responds by email if you need help or advice.

Thank you for your professionalism.

Valérie

I'm sad that Dr. Jaffar has passed away. I trusted him completely, and my animals were 100% safe. The insurance paperwork was all set. 👍 He was truly wonderful; we'll miss him—in fact, I already do—but I wish him a very happy retirement. …
Dr. Will is a professional and welcoming veterinarian who gives lots of good advice. Oreo felt comfortable during the consultation. I recommend her 👍 …

My animals have been going to this clinic for years, and they're simply wonderful. The staff is passionate and competent, a trustworthy team that works because everyone is top-notch.
Thank you for everything you do.
Friendly welcome. Efficient. Professional.
Perfect place to make the life of your pet easier and happier 😊 …

The vets are fantastic, the reception staff are also super friendly and very helpful. They take the time to explain everything about my pets and answer my questions thoroughly. Above all, they are a very professional and welcoming team. My dogs Ruby and Stardust are treated at this clinic, and I feel very reassured and confident. I sincerely recommend it.
Excellent welcome and care for my Mya, who is usually timid. The vet was patient and gentle with her. She was also attentive and offered good advice.

I came in as an emergency with my dog ​​for a wound that needed staples, and they saw me without an appointment. It was all over in 15 minutes, and we left with my dog, his cone, and his antibiotics! Thank you so much, this clinic is truly fantastic!
A very nice team, very friendly, welcoming, and competent and attentive veterinarians.
Excellent clinic that I highly recommend. The staff is professional and friendly, and the vet is fantastic. Thank you again for taking such good care of Prosper the cat; he's doing great today.
Thank you for taking the time to post this review. However, we have no record of a customer named Valentina Cogliandro in our database.
Very condescending and inhumane staff, exorbitant prices.
These professionals love their work and the animals they work with. They are very kind and do everything they can to help the animals recover.

A very attentive and caring veterinarian.
I've been treating my animals there for years. Highly professional.
A top-notch neighborhood clinic

Excellent. Friendly staff and vet.
My policy is followed there without any problems.
Great team, very friendly and professional. 😺 …
Good

No respect for the animal, incompetence...
Of the four people I spoke with, only one was competent; the other three were unworthy of their responsibility, including the receptionist. I won't waste any more time describing the ins and outs, but know that if the vet offers to inject any liquid into your pet to "rehydrate" it, refuse. If I hadn't miraculously woken up in the middle of the night to find my pet suffocating, it would have died, suffocated by the liquid filling its lungs. It was saved at the last minute by being taken to the emergency room where they treated its unconsciousness.

I would add that a very rough "grip," normally only used when the animal is struggling, was applied in order to more easily apply a bandage, which, by the way, was far too tight/sloppy. Furthermore, at each visit, I had to personally recall the file and point out that the animal's history and the context of the consultation needed to be checked on the computer. The veterinarian also took the liberty of leaving the room for several minutes in the middle of a consultation... The organization needs to be reviewed.

I cannot recommend this clinic, and I find it absurd that it has a 4.7 rating.
